title.value: 3D P RE - TRAINING IMPROVES GNN S FOR M OLECULAR P ROPERTY P REDICTION
title.justification: The title '3D P RE - TRAINING IMPROVES GNN S FOR M OLECULAR P ROPERTY P REDICTION' directly states the central focus of the paper is on improving Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) for predicting molecular properties using 3D pre-training techniques.
title.quote: 3D P RE - TRAINING IMPROVES GNN S FOR M OLECULAR P ROPERTY P REDICTION Anonymous authors Paper under double-blind review

extractions.description: The paper discusses a novel approach of pre-training Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) to predict molecular properties by utilizing 3D molecular structures even when computationally infeasible scales demand reliance solely on 2D representations. The authors propose a method named '3D Infomax', which uses mutual information maximization between 2D and 3D structures to embed latent 3D geometric information into GNNs. This technique improves predictions for a variety of molecular properties and offers transferable benefits across different molecular datasets.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper's application to predicting molecular properties has direct implications in drug discovery and materials science, both of which contribute significantly to Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). It mentions potential applications related to energy storage and generation, which are crucial for clean energy transition and climate change mitigation.
